name: io.github.brajendrak00068/levea-mcp-server
title: Levea — Autonomous AI Video Editor (hosted OAuth or npx)
description: Autonomous AI video editor over MCP: viral clips, captions, reframe, chroma key, MP4 export.

environmentVariables.name: LEVEA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Levea API base URL, e.g. https://api.livecore.ai

environmentVariables.name: LEVEA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Levea API key, only for this local stdio package (clients that cannot use the hosted endpoint https://api.livecore.ai/api/v1/misc/mcp, which signs in with OAuth and needs no key). Tools list without it; edits need it. Generate one at https://livecore.ai/?openclaw=1&utm_source=mcp-registry&utm_medium=mcp-server&utm_campaign=levea-mcp-server

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Levea API key> (or connect with OAuth 2.1). Generate one at https://livecore.ai/?openclaw=1&utm_source=mcp-registry&utm_medium=hosted-mcp&utm_campaign=levea-mcp-server
